sages.name: ECHOSAGE
sages.notes: Stands in for a CLI that reads the prompt on stdin and answers inside a JSON envelope (claude -p --output-format json). It wraps the prompt it received into {"result": ...}, so a correct extraction returns the prompt text.

sages.name: FILESAGE
sages.notes: Stands in for a CLI that takes the prompt as a file path and answers on bare stdout (grok --prompt-file, or Antigravity with extract: raw).

sages.name: ANSWERSAGE
sages.notes: Stands in for a CLI that writes its final message to a file instead of stdout (codex exec --output-last-message). $1 is the substituted {ANSWER_FILE}.
